AI-Based Methodology for Early Damage Detection 3.1 Overview The developed data-driven AI-based methodology for detecting damage in bridges, based on train-induced dynamic response, entails the four operations shown in Fig. 5: (i) damage sensitive feature extraction from the acquired structural responses, (ii) feature modelling to remove environmental and operational effects, (iii) data fusion to merge multi-sensor features without losing damage related information, and, (iv) feature discrimination to classify the extracted features in two categories, healthy or damaged.
